title: Model Intake Orchestra and Comms Baton
creator: Aditi Sharma
description:
Purpose: provide a single operational checklist (the 'Comms Baton') that PM hands off to Eng/Design/Docs/Marketing for production-ready addition of a new model variant into the Redwood catalog. This ticket coordinates gating criteria, release-notes copy, benchmark artifacts, docs updates, and the announcement schedule.

Scope: model addition to hosted Redwood API and catalog; covers: perf verification, quality checks, release-notes generation, docs/SDK updates, marketing comms, console metadata, telemetry hooks, and post-launch monitoring runbook. Not covering Dedicated onboarding steps beyond catalog metadata sync.
acceptance_criteria: All gating checks passed: perf SLOs, token-cost targets, and quality regressions below threshold
Release-notes draft written and approved by PM + Legal + Security
Benchmarks (latency, throughput, cost) uploaded and linked in catalog entry
Docs and SDK examples updated and merged to docs-site/main
Announcement assets (blog draft, changelog entry, marketing brief) scheduled
Console model tile shows correct metadata and rollout flags
Telemetry events (model_id, variant, rollout_stage) emitted to staging and validated
Post-launch smoke runbook published and on-call notified
checklist: Intake: Confirm model spec and variant name; verify license and export controls
Intake: Confirm model weights location (GCS/S3) and checksum; record model hash
Validation: Run standard perf harness (p95 latency, throughput with typical batch sizes)
Validation: Run quality eval suite (prompt set A/B, rouge/semantic metrics) and capture regression deltas
Validation: Run adversarial/edge-case prompts for hallucination regression
Infra: Ensure quantization profile is available and compatible with runtime kernels
Infra: Confirm kernel/engine flags and fallback variants are defined
Benchmarks: Produce single-table benchmark CSV (latency/us, tokens/sec, cost/token) and attach
Docs: Update model catalog entry draft with model description, intended use-cases, known limitations, and example prompts
Docs: Update SDK examples (python/js) and add structured output examples if applicable
Release notes: Draft short-form and long-form entries; include migration guidance if any API changes
Legal/Security: Confirm PII/data handling guidance and include KMS/HSM notes if relevant
Design: Provide hero screenshot for console and create model tile icon variant
Marketing: Draft announcement blog and short social blurbs; collect screenshots and benchmark highlights
Console: Add rollout stages and canary percentage flags; set default fallback policy
Telemetry: Add model_id to request logs, enable latency/cost tagging per token, and wire up new dashboards
QA: Run end-to-end smoke on staging (token generation, streaming, embeddings where applicable)
Ops: Create post-launch alert thresholds (error rate, p95 latency, cost spikes) and link runbook
Launch: Schedule go/no-go sync 24h and 1h prior to public announcement
Post-launch: Collect first-48h telemetry, surface top 3 regressions to PM, Eng, and Design
notes: Decision: Canary start at 5% for first 6 hours, escalate to 25% after stability checks pass
Trade-off: quantized variant reduces cost by ~40% but increases p95 by ~8ms — acceptable given latency SLO
Follow-up: If hallucination delta >0.6 (semantic score), hold public announcement and open mitigation EPIC

risks: Quality regression larger than expected requiring rollback
Telemetry gaps preventing quick root cause analysis
Unexpected cost spikes with wide rollout
mitigations: Automatic rollback policy configured for >=2% error-rate increase sustained for 10 minutes
Preflight telemetry sanity checks and smoke dashboard with synthetic traffic
Keep announcement staged behind feature flag for first 48h for enterprise customers
Rate-limit large batch sizes and enforce per-customer quotas during initial rollout
